title: Conditions of Sale for Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions
content:
These conditions govern the sale, start, price and payment of every Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product.

## 1. Who may buy

1.1 A subscription is sold only to a customer with an open Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program who is at least the subscription's minimum age, in years.

1.2 A subscription is bought only when the customer's Summit membership status is enrolled, active or dormant.

1.3 The membership status in 1.2 is the status of the buying customer's own Summit membership as the company's records show it at the time of purchase, before the purchase is recorded; the customer's own description of the membership does not replace the record.

| Summit membership status on the buyer's record | Subscription bought under 1.2 |
|---|---|
| Enrolled | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Dormant | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

## 2. Term

2.1 The term starts the subscription's days from purchase to start, counted in calendar days after the purchase, and runs the subscription's term, counted in calendar months, to the end date recorded on the subscription.

## 3. Price and payment

3.1 The price is one of the following, according to how the term is paid:
- **up front:** the subscription's price of one term paid up front, in USD;
- **monthly:** the subscription's monthly installment per month, when monthly billing is available for that subscription, with at least the subscription's commitment number of installments owed;
- **miles:** the subscription's miles price, in Summit miles, when that subscription may be paid entirely in Summit miles.

3.2 Summit Silver and higher members receive the subscription's Summit Silver and higher discount, as a percentage off cash prices.

3.3 A flight credit is never accepted in payment.

3.4 A monthly installment that fails for the number of calendar days the subscription sets for a failed monthly installment cancels the subscription.

## 4. Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures, not tariff values)

**Discount on a cash price.** Take a hypothetical up-front price of 600 USD and a hypothetical Summit Silver and higher discount of 10 percent. A member at Summit Silver or a higher tier pays 600 USD less 10 percent of 600 USD, that is 540 USD.

**Monthly billing.** A subscription billed monthly at a hypothetical installment of 50 USD with a hypothetical commitment of 12 installments is sold with at least 12 installments of 50 USD owed.

**Payment with a flight credit.** A customer who offers a Crestline flight credit toward any subscription price cannot use it under 3.3, whatever the subscription.
